scope: One AC1024 DWG-origin ACAD_SUN dictionary profile, with same-revision typed DXF output and fresh readback
claim_effect: Closes this bounded source/graph/output profile only. It does not qualify strict whole-file output from the physical sample, other producer/version profiles, or native lighting semantics.

authority.document: Open Design Specification for .dwg files, v5.4.1

sections.finding: Handle codes 2/3 denote soft/hard ownership. Relative handle encodings represent soft pointers; the parser resolves these to code 7.
The common parent handle of a non-entity object is a soft pointer.
A DICTIONARY has a soft-pointer parent; item-handle ownership follows its hardOwner flag.

secondary_authority.finding: Group 280 set to 1 means dictionary elements are treated as hard-owned; group 350 is the soft-owner entry handle in the ACAD_SUN hardOwner=0 profile.

observed_edges.role: relative soft pointer resolved by the parser

physical_source_observation.limits: These parser observations establish the source graph and roles. The sample's strict CLI conversion still stops at the global incomplete DWG read-disposition gate before output graph validation; no physical whole-file output is claimed.

behavior: DICTIONARY DWG parsing rejects each non-null item handle whose wire role disagrees with the parsed hardOwner flag, and clears typed state on failure.
The generic extension graph admits the canonical 360 edge only when it is rooted at the NOD ACAD_SUN dictionary and the typed SUN has a reciprocal parent handle.
The dedicated SUN owner validator requires one unaliased ACAD_SUN root, a complete one-entry 360 dictionary with hardOwner=0, and a unique typed SUN whose parentHandle names that dictionary.
The dictionary route is limited to same-revision AC1024 DWG input/output; VIEW, VPORT, and VIEWPORT hard-owner routes retain their existing gates.

checks: ACAD_SUN root and 360 dictionary item are emitted and remapped.
The item is read back as group 350 soft ownership, and the SUN's group 330 parent points back to the dictionary.
The typed SUN and dictionary graph survive fresh readback alongside VIEW, VPORT, and VIEWPORT-owned SUN records.
An unsupported CMC color preserves a pre-existing destination before the same writer is corrected and retried.

valid_cases: A code-2 item under hardOwner=0 parses and leaves the following sentinel handle aligned.
A code-3 item under hardOwner=1 parses.
invalid_cases: Changing the item handle to code 3 under hardOwner=0 is rejected and typed entries reset.
Changing the item handle to code 2 under hardOwner=1 is rejected and typed entries reset.

validation.object_vectors_result: build-gcc/libdxfrw_dwg_object_vectors_tests: PASS after code-2/hardOwner-0, code-3/hardOwner-1, both mismatch refusals, and following-sentinel alignment controls.

strict_physical_export.result: Exit 1 at strict-complete conversion requires successful, complete DWG read disposition; the output file was absent.

remaining: Other SUN producer/version and dictionary-owner profiles remain unqualified.
The physical source drawing still lacks strict whole-file read completeness; this slice does not bypass that refusal.
Native SUN lighting/rendering and composed whole-document compatibility remain open.
